_comment: Combo guide for every playable Chiara x Bianca pairing. Presentation and design reference only: the rules live in the cards, statuses, passives and data/combat/reactions.json. strength: 3 = signature combo, 2 = strong, 1 = light. engine: aether | momentum | reaction | status.

combos.name: Aether Hymns
combos.text: Chiara's extra cards and Energy become Aether; Bianca's hymns grow with it and Lightfall releases it all.

combos.name: Runic Wall
combos.text: Aether hardens Bianca's guard: Runic Bastion gains Block for every point of it.

combos.name: Hexed Powder
combos.text: Smoke Bomb and Shadowstep draw into more Aether, and Hexed Powder turns it into Fire on every foe.

combos.name: Distilled Venom
combos.text: Distilled Venom brews more Poison with every point of Aether Chiara conjures.

combos.name: Ignition
combos.text: Bianca soaks foes in Oil; every Oiled stack makes Chiara's Fire hit 15% harder, and Ignition Strike burns it away.

combos.name: Combustion
combos.text: Bianca stacks Poison; Chiara's Fire detonates it: each Poison stack explodes for 3 Fire damage on EVERY enemy.

combos.name: Purifying Flame
combos.text: Bianca's Holy strikes on Burning foes feed her Block (1 per Burn), and Sunfire Smite hits Burning foes harder.

combos.name: Searing Bash
combos.text: Bianca's heavy blows fan the flames (+1 Burn), and Branding Bash punishes Burning foes.

combos.name: Brittle
combos.text: Chill makes foes take more Physical damage and act later; Bianca's shield blows shatter them.

combos.name: Shatterlight
combos.text: Bianca's Holy light shatters Chill: 2 Holy damage per stack, and Sunfire Smite hits Chilled foes harder.

combos.name: Black Ice
combos.text: Frost freezes the oil: Frost hits on Oiled foes add 1 extra Chill, and Chill opens them to Bianca's blades.

combos.name: Frostbite
combos.text: Frost locks the venom in: Frost hits on Poisoned foes add 2 Poison, while Chill keeps them from acting.

combos.name: Miasma
combos.text: Every Wind hit on a Poisoned foe blows half its Poison onto every other enemy; Gusts make it a storm.

combos.name: Fanned Oil
combos.text: Wind hits spray Oil across the enemy line, and Scatter spreads Bleed and Oil at once.

combos.name: Momentum
combos.text: Gusts and cheap cards raise Momentum; Momentum Bash hits harder for every card already played.

combos.name: Psalm of Wings
combos.text: Chiara's flurries shield the party through Psalm of Wings, and her draws fill Aether for the hymns.
